description: This PHP class 'FreeCheckout' is part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically in the catalog model extension for payment. It provides a method to determine if a 'free checkout' payment method should be available based on cart totals and subscription status.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: A model class responsible for providing the 'free checkout' payment method based on cart totals and subscription status.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Determines whether the 'free checkout' payment method is available, returning method details if applicable.
